stem: When using the ABCD toxicity clues in an unwell child, which finding best fits A?

options.text: Reduced fluid intake or urine output

explanation: A stands for reduced alertness, arousal, or activity in the ABCD toxicity framework.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because A in the ABCD toxicity framework refers to reduced alertness, arousal, or activity.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because cool peripheries with central cyanosis fit colour or circulation concerns rather than A.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because breathing difficulty corresponds to B for breathing.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because reduced fluid intake or urine output corresponds to D.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because a weak or high-pitched cry is not the defining feature for A in this framework.
